title: Settlement Shares for Finish Items by Defect Category — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
A finish-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is struck on the item under settlement: the claim item of the most recent workmanship approval recorded on the coverage, whether that approval is the item's original approval or an accepted callback. The settlement share is the part of the program's cash-in-lieu maximum that the scheduled finish settlement starts from; it multiplies that maximum.

**Rule.** The settlement share follows the defect category of the item under settlement, as the item was filed: a flooring, tile or cabinets and countertops item takes a share of 0.60; a paint, drywall or trim carpentry item takes a share of 0.30; any other workmanship category takes the standard share of 0.45.

| Defect category of the item under settlement | Settlement share |
|---|---|
| flooring | 0.60 |
| tile | 0.60 |
| cabinets and countertops | 0.60 |
| paint | 0.30 |
| drywall | 0.30 |
| trim carpentry | 0.30 |
| any other workmanship category | 0.45 |

**Identifying the item.** The item is fixed by the latest workmanship approval on the coverage. Where an earlier approval concerned a tile item and the latest workmanship approval is an accepted callback on a paint item, the item under settlement is the paint item and the share is 0.30.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Under a program whose cash-in-lieu maximum is USD 1000.00, a share of 0.60 starts the scheduled finish settlement from USD 600.00 of that maximum, a share of 0.30 from USD 300.00.
